title: Graduated Return After Military Service: Size of the Payment Step
content:
**Rule.** For a Servicemember Rate Cap Benefit of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the payment step is the pre-plan installment recorded on the benefit less the installment now in force on the benefit's loan, as a percentage of the pre-plan installment; a step of at least 10 percent adds one graduated-return due date for every full 5 percent of the step, any remainder being dropped; a step of at least 5 but under 10 percent adds one; a smaller step, or a benefit missing its pre-plan installment, adds none. The installment now in force is the scheduled installment on the loan's Personal Loans record.

## Working the step (hypothetical installments)

| Pre-plan installment on the benefit | Installment now in force | Step | Graduated-return due dates added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 25 percent | 5 (five full steps of 5 percent) |
| 400.00 USD | 356.00 USD | 11 percent | 2 (two full steps; the remaining 1 percent dropped) |
| 400.00 USD | 360.00 USD | 10 percent | 2 |
| 400.00 USD | 372.00 USD | 7 percent | 1 |
| 400.00 USD | 390.00 USD | 2.5 percent | none |
| not recorded | any | — | none |
